Today’s work and leave

Choose from five modes for today.

Understand regular days, half days, Lulu days and leave, including their effect on retained arrivals.

Five modes: Mac 1.5.15 build31 · Windows 1.5.13: regular and half days
OverviewHow to useExampleScope and limitsRelated features

A choice for today

Mac offers regular, morning off, afternoon off, Lulu and leave without a calendar connection. Selecting a mode does not create an arrival. A choice incompatible with the saved arrival window is rejected.

Windows 1.5.13 supports regular and half-day calculations with manual selection. It does not include the new Mac five-mode panel, Lulu, leave or an explicit regular-day override of the reduction.

Choose a mode and understand the calculation

  1. On Mac, click the selected workday mode in the panel, or open Settings → Work → Today’s work and leave.
  2. Choose today’s mode, then check arrival and expected departure.
  3. After leave, choose regular or a half day again, or save a manual arrival to resume calculations.
  • Automatic regular day: add configured work and break time; subtract 120 minutes on the last Friday.
  • Explicit regular choice: on Mac, set the reduction to zero even on the last Friday.
  • Morning or afternoon off: four hours without a break or an extra Friday reduction.
  • Lulu: reduce a regular day by 120 minutes, without combining it with a half day.
  • Leave: pause automatic arrival and the countdown while retaining the arrival.

One 09:00 arrival, different departures

With eight work hours and one break hour, 09:00 gives 18:00 on a regular day, 16:00 on a Lulu day and 13:00 with afternoon off. Morning off requires a 13:00–15:00 arrival, so it cannot be applied to that same 09:00 record.

An automatic regular day on the last Friday gives 16:00. Explicitly choosing regular on Mac removes the reduction and gives 18:00. Windows 1.5.13 does not offer this explicit override.

Leave and Day off are different

Leave retains the existing arrival. The separate Take today off action deletes today’s arrival after confirmation. It can also delete the arrival retained during leave.

A manual choice takes priority over automatic calendar recognition. The automatic last-Friday rule uses the calendar date and does not move for holidays.

These choices are local personal classifications. They do not submit company leave requests, calculate a leave balance or assign modes to past or future dates.
